races.name: Join Racing TV Today Maiden Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners_data.name: Final Appeal
runners_data.comment: Beaten a neck into second of five at Nottingham on Wednesday; experience invaluable
runners_data.spotlight: January foal by Inns Of Court; 37,000euros yearling; half-brother to 7f winner Kodiac Brown Bear (RPR 76); dam unplaced 1m AW 2yo (44), half-sister to Australian 1m4f Group 1 winner Sir John Hawkwood; 5-4 when beaten a neck into second of five at Nottingham (5f, good) on Wednesday; this would come very soon afterwards, but that experience could be invaluable if taking his chance.

runners_data.name: Hicko's Lad
runners_data.comment: Stable 4-76 (5%) with 2yo newcomers in past five seasons; probably best watched
runners_data.spotlight: April foal by Mattmu; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to 8.6f winner Host, out of maiden half-sister to Group-placed 7f/1m winner Rare Ransom; already gelded; stable 4-76 (5%) with 2yo newcomers in past five seasons; probably best watched.

runners_data.name: Hickory Lad
runners_data.comment: Stable 2-20 (10%) with 2yo newcomers since 2022; market helpful
runners_data.spotlight: March foal by James Garfield; 9,000euros yearling; brother to Qatari 5.5f/6f winner Bluey's Boy, half-brother to winners Assimilation (7f-1m2f AW; RPR 105), Keep On Moving (Swedish 7f) and Princess Park (Hungarian 6f); dam 5f/6f 2yo winner (82); stable 2-20 (10%) with 2yo newcomers since 2022; market helpful.

runners_data.name: Rbflying
runners_data.comment: Something to like on breeding, but stable 5-188 (3%) with 2yo newcomers since 2022
runners_data.spotlight: March foal by Kodi Bear; 70,000euros foal; 70,000gns yearling; half-brother to seven US/Canadian winners including Samurai's Garden (6.5f/1m dirt) and Gardenly (1m dirt); dam 6f winner (RPR 74), half-sister to 5f Group 3 winner Enticing (dam of multiple 7f Group 1 winner One Master); something to like on breeding, but stable 5-188 (3%) with 2yo newcomers since 2022.

runners_data.name: Regal Adventure
runners_data.comment: Already gelded and stable 1-90 with 2yo newcomers in last five seasons; better for the run
runners_data.spotlight: April foal by Coulsty; 28,000euros yearling; half-brother to Polish 5f 2yo winner My Snow White; dam unplaced 5f-6f 2yo (including AW; RPR 56), closely related to UAE 6f 2yo winner Desert Of Dreams, half-sister to 5f-6f winner Grand Zafeen, out of 7f Group 3 winner; already gelded and stable 1-90 with 2yo newcomers in last five seasons; may be better for the run.

runners_data.name: Thebesthasyetocome
runners_data.comment: Stable 3-52 with 2yo newcomers since 2022; worth a second look given his purchase price
runners_data.spotlight: February foal by Starman; £100,000 yearling; dam placed 7f/1m in France (including 2yo), sister to Hungarian 1m2f winner Polaris Dancer, half-sister to 11.4f/1m4f winner Escarpment, out of French 6f/7f winner; stable 3-52 with 2yo newcomers since 2022, but worth a second look given his purchase price, especially if attracting support.

runners_data.name: Too Many Spirits
runners_data.comment: Already gelded; stable 1-14 with 2yo newcomers since 2024; market to guide
runners_data.spotlight: April foal by Rajasinghe; brother to 6f 2yo winner Hougoumont (including AW; RPR 78); dam 5f winner (including 2yo/AW; 84), half-sister to Listed-placed 6f 2yo winner Byzantium, out of 5f winning close relative of useful 5f/6f winner Texas Gold; already gelded; stable 1-14 with 2yo newcomers since 2024; market to guide.

runners_data.name: Turnstile
runners_data.comment: Speedy pedigree offers hope, but he would be a rare winning newcomer from the stable
runners_data.spotlight: April foal by Territories; half-brother to winners Pivoting (6f 2yo; RPR 79), U Turn (5f 2yo; 70) and Rotation (6f 2yo; 66); dam placed 5f 2yo (62), out of 5f winning half-sister to 6f Group 1 winner G Force; speedy pedigree offers hope, but he would be a rare winning newcomer from the stable.

runners_data.name: Where Love Lives
runners_data.comment: Enough to like on breeding; stable 21-192 (11%) with 2yo newcomers since 2022; respected
runners_data.spotlight: February foal by Cotai Glory; £55,000 yearling; half-brother to Italian 7f 2yo winner Inbetty; dam 5f/6f 2yo winner (including AW; RPR 88), half-sister to winners Compton Poppy (5f including 2yo) and Bon Port (7f/1m including 2yo), out of maiden half-sister to 5f Group 1 winner Kyllachy; enough to like on breeding and stable 21-192 (11%) with 2yo newcomers in past five seasons; respected, especially if backed.

races.name: racingtv.com Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands C And D) (GBB Race) (Div I)

runners_data.name: Simon Pierre
runners_data.comment: Although tenth of 12 at Doncaster recently, he was beaten only 7.5l.
runners_data.spotlight: Cost 72,000euros as a 2yo and the maiden he contested at the Lincoln meeting (7f, good to soft) was dominated by well-bred horses from good yards; although tenth of 12, he was beaten only 7.5l.

runners_data.name: Simba's Pride
runners_data.comment: Fourth of ten over 5f on debut nearly a year ago; raised significantly in trip
runners_data.spotlight: 2,000gns yearling; beaten under 5l over 5f at Thirsk but that was nearly a year ago and he's up markedly in trip this time; pedigree is quite speedy.

runners_data.name: Arc At Her
runners_data.comment: The only runner who lacks experience but makes sense to check the betting
runners_data.spotlight: 20,000gns yearling; sixth foal; half-sister to winners All Go (6f-1m) and Dea Giulia (Italian 9.5f); dam 2m winner (RPR 64) and very well related; the only runner who lacks experience but makes sense to check the betting.

runners_data.name: Clonquest
runners_data.comment: Came from well off the pace to finish second at Newcastle (7f) in January
runners_data.spotlight: Came from well off the pace to finish second at Newcastle (7f) in January and the winner went in again next time; that run sets the standard here and this colt's debut was also encouraging.

runners_data.name: Sayidah Aleen
runners_data.comment: Made a quiet start when last to finish at Wolverhampton where she was a weak 12-1 chance
runners_data.spotlight: 42,000euros yearling; made a quiet start when last to finish at Wolverhampton where she was a weak 12-1 chance.

runners_data.name: My Ballyquinn
runners_data.comment: Ran moderately over 1m at Ripon last year but has been gelded ahead of this second season
runners_data.spotlight: Ran moderately over 1m at Ripon last year (good to firm; 18-1) but has been gelded ahead of this second season.

runners_data.name: Luscious Lil
runners_data.comment: 50-1 and was a remote eighth over 1m at Southwell 20 days ago; one for handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: 50-1 and was a remote eighth over 1m at Southwell 20 days ago; one for handicaps.

runners_data.name: Mayflower Billy
runners_data.comment: Trailed home last at Chelmsford in August (7f) when 100-1 and cheekpieces are now removed
runners_data.spotlight: Trailed home last at Chelmsford in August (7f) when 100-1 and cheekpieces are now removed.

runners_data.name: Raja Charger
runners_data.comment: Three heavy defeats have earned him a basement handicap mark; no appeal
runners_data.spotlight: Three heavy defeats have earned him a basement handicap mark; no appeal.

races.name: racingtv.com Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands C And D) (GBB Race) (Div II)

runners_data.name: Pepsea
runners_data.comment: Best watched on debut unless the betting strongly hints otherwise
runners_data.spotlight: 20,000euros gelded son of Far Above and the second foal of a half-sister to 6f/7f Listed winner Gusto; probably best watched on debut.

runners_data.name: Bearish
runners_data.comment: Promise in warm race on last autumn's Newmarket debut; should be hard to beat on return
runners_data.spotlight: Promising fourth of 15 in 7f Newmarket novice (good) on debut last October; that form has been boosted and he should be very hard to beat on his return to action with improvement likely.

runners_data.name: Inferno
runners_data.comment: Promise on second of two AW outings last November; more to come in 2026
runners_data.spotlight: Both runs on Newcastle's Tapeta last November, leaving 7f debut behind when third over 1m; should be more to come this year.

runners_data.name: Tough Date
runners_data.comment: Better effort over 1m on AW last month when third at Southwell; may do better again
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten a long way on 1m Southwell debut last month but showed promise when third of nine at Southwell (1m again) nine days later; may do better again.

runners_data.name: Bridgefoot Rambler
runners_data.comment: Beaten 24l when sixth of seven on Ripon debut last year; significant improvement needed
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten 24l when sixth of seven on debut at Ripon (1m2f, good; 80-1) seven months ago and needs to show significant improvement.

runners_data.name: Supreme Lillia
runners_data.comment: Third on AW debut last November but only seventh back there four weeks ago
runners_data.spotlight: Fair effort when third on 7f Newcastle debut in November but only sixth of seven back there 110 days later; even a return to the debut form likely wouldn't be enough to trouble Bearish.

runners_data.name: Alcanzor
runners_data.comment: Well held in two outings last autumn and likely more one for handicaps after this
runners_data.spotlight: Well held in two outings last autumn and likely more one for handicaps after this.

runners_data.name: Rocklaw
runners_data.comment: Well beaten in a pair of Southwell novices and more one for handicaps.
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in a pair of Southwell novices and more one for handicaps.

runners_data.name: Nefyn Queen
runners_data.comment: Well held in two 7f AW starts; Tough Date looks the stable first string
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in two 7f AW starts in recent months; Tough Date looks the stable first string.

races.name: Live Streams On Racing TV Extra Handicap

runners_data.name: Eve's Boy
runners_data.comment: 0-12 in handicaps but down to mark in 60s for first time; return to form no surprise
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to add to his 2yo novice win but is down to a mark in the 60s for the first time now back on the grass after a two-month break; a return to form wouldn't surprise.

runners_data.name: Harswell Ruby
runners_data.comment: Not disgraced on AW return and feasibly treated on last year's turf efforts; considered
runners_data.spotlight: Had several close calls on turf in the second half of last year; not disgraced back from four months off at Newcastle three weeks ago; 1-22 overall but she could be very competitive with that run behind her.

runners_data.name: Volto Di Medusa
runners_data.comment: Dual 1m winner; promise in recent AW starts; one of more likely types
runners_data.spotlight: Dual 1m winner (good turf/AW); ran well for third at Wolverhampton last month and shaped quite nicely again (caught too far back) when fifth over 1m2f at Lingfield (AW) a fortnight ago; one of the more likely types.

runners_data.name: Mariner
runners_data.comment: Should be sharper for recent AW return and now 1lb below his last winning mark
runners_data.spotlight: Winner over 1m at Doncaster (good to firm) and 1m2f at Ripon (good) last spring; minor late headway on his recent AW reappearance and he's dipped to 1lb below the mark he defied at Ripon.

runners_data.name: Jewel Maker
runners_data.comment: This veteran is a 12-time winner but always behind on recent AW reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran with 12 wins to his name but didn't suggest his next one is near when trailing throughout on his AW reappearance three weeks ago.

runners_data.name: Amidst The Chaos
runners_data.comment: Won first two handicaps and excuses for two subsequent defeats; claims if ready to roll
runners_data.spotlight: Started his handicap career with wins at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) and Musselburgh (1m1f, good) last August; had excuses for his two subsequent defeats (too keen upped to 1m4f final start) and retains unexposed potential; claims if fully primed after six months off.

runners_data.name: Jamaican Storm
runners_data.comment: Finally came good on AW latest but down the field all four turf starts last year
runners_data.spotlight: Placed twice in March prior to making it 17th time lucky at Newcastle (1m) a fortnight ago; arrives fit and in form but eighth is the best he's managed in four previous turf outings.

runners_data.name: Pol Roger
runners_data.comment: Well treated back from a 140-day break but a losing run of 21 doesn't inspire confidence
runners_data.spotlight: Lost his way in the autumn; has dropped to a favourable mark as a result (went close off 5lb higher last autumn) but a losing run of 21 doesn't inspire confidence; first start for 140 days.

runners_data.name: Travis
runners_data.comment: Course winner; arrives in form from AW; stall 12 not ideal but should still go well
runners_data.spotlight: Just two wins from his 30 starts but placed over 1m/7f on Newcastle's Tapeta on his last four outings, the latest on reappearance a fortnight ago; successful over 7f here last summer and should go well if stall 12 isn't too big an inconvenience.

runners_data.name: Finally Escaped
runners_data.comment: Unexposed after four AW starts but will need improvement switching to turf in headgear
runners_data.spotlight: Unexposed after four AW starts in recent months but never involved when sixth of eight on 1m Southwell handicap debut 13 days ago; has raced keenly and a first-time hood and tongue-tie are reached for now switching to turf; improvement will be needed.

runners_data.name: Whiskey Pete
runners_data.comment: Placed off higher marks over 1m2f last year; betting perhaps best guide after 179 days off
runners_data.spotlight: Useful for Ralph Beckett but nowhere near that level for this yard last year, albeit placed twice over 1m2f at Doncaster off his reduced mark at the end of last summer; off six months; the betting should help guide to expectations.

races.name: British EBF Michael Foster Conditions Stakes

runners_data.name: Poet Master
runners_data.comment: Group 2 winner; second at that level on final 5yo start; goes well fresh; leading claims
runners_data.spotlight: Raced almost exclusively at 7f; Group 2 winner in Ireland as a 4yo; ran close to that level when second in Longchamp Group 3 (very soft) and the Group 2 Challenge at Newmarket (good; Scoville 5.5l back in fourth) last autumn; disappointing on his 2025 reappearance but won first time up in 2023 and 2024; leading form claims.

runners_data.name: Elarak
runners_data.comment: Smart effort when ready winner of 7f Newmarket handicap last autumn; likely more to come
runners_data.spotlight: Back on the up with a bang returned to 7f and ridden positively when ready winner of a handicap at Newmarket (good to firm) last September; subsequently gelded; has the potential for even better this year and his stable is no stranger to success in this, including in the Shadwell silks.

runners_data.name: Seacruiser
runners_data.comment: Made all in 1m Newmarket maiden in September 2024 but hasn't been seen since
runners_data.spotlight: Looked a good prospect when making all in a 1m Newmarket maiden (good to soft) in September 2024 but hasn't been seen since; could be the sort to make up for lost time this year but this is a big ask on only his third start after such a long absence; has been gelded.

runners_data.name: Mount Athos
runners_data.comment: Second in this in 2023 and 2025; once again arrives after a 7f Kempton win; should go well
runners_data.spotlight: Running in this for the third time, finishing second in 2023 and 2025; on both occasions he arrived on the back of a 7f win at Kempton and he landed that same race yet again 23 days ago; should give it another good shot.

runners_data.name: Scoville
runners_data.comment: Behind Poet Master final run but promise of 14l novice win still fresh in memory; gelded
runners_data.spotlight: Won 1m novices on good to firm on his first two outings, on the second occasion making all by a whopping 14l at Newmarket; didn't confirm that abundant promise in two subsequent Group races (including 5.5l behind Poet Master at Newmarket) but still very early days and could easily resume his progression on this reappearance having been gelded.

runners_data.name: Darkness
runners_data.comment: Useful C&D winner but has plenty to finds on these terms
runners_data.spotlight: Useful sort who landed fast-ground handicap wins over C&D and at Goodwood last year; however, he has plenty to find on these terms and failed to beat a rival on his reappearance in 2024 and 2025.

runners_data.name: Rhoscolyn
runners_data.comment: Hasn't beaten a rival in the last two runnings of this and surely up against it
runners_data.spotlight: Last year's Golden Mile win at Goodwood (strong record there) shows he's still smart on his day; third in this in 2022 but hasn't beaten a rival in the last two runnings (all reappearance); safe to look elsewhere.

runners_data.name: Myal
runners_data.comment: Most progressive at 7f, including Listed second last autumn; sharper for recent 6f return
runners_data.spotlight: Most progressive in the last couple of years, winning six 7f handicaps, with the first gained off of a rating of 67; another career-best effort when second in 7f Redcar Listed race (good to soft) on his final 4yo start; should be spot on for this after finishing fifth of 12 in a 6f Doncaster Listed event on his reappearance 13 days ago.

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Asmen Warrior
runners_data.comment: Thereabouts in his handicaps for James Owen and this slightly longer trip is worth a go
runners_data.spotlight: Sixth career run when the odds-on winner for a 1m2f maiden for previous yard; bar one blip, he's been thereabouts in his handicaps for James Owen and this slightly longer trip is worth a go.

runners_data.name: Pride Of Donegal
runners_data.comment: Bolted up on the AW last weekend he's 3lb well in under a penalty
runners_data.spotlight: Consistent 4yo who has really raised his game since the blinkers went on, twice making all over 1m4f at Wolverhampton; it was never in doubt there last weekend and he's 3lb well in under a penalty; unraced on turf.

runners_data.name: Gibside
runners_data.comment: Often seen over further these days and may now need slower ground at this trip
runners_data.spotlight: The ground was soft when winning over this far at Catterick in October and he's usually seen over further these days; under these conditions he may be found wanting for some pace.

runners_data.name: In The Breeze
runners_data.comment: Returns to his last winning trip and could go well if ready for action after his break
runners_data.spotlight: Won at Pontefract (1m4f, good to soft) in September off just 3lb lower and final three defeats for Mick Appleby were over further; could go well if ready for action after his break.

runners_data.name: Roarin' Success
runners_data.comment: Competitively treated on his form for Harry Charlton; fair form over hurdles for this yard
runners_data.spotlight: Competitively treated on her form for Harry Charlton and she's not performed badly over hurdles for current yard; had a wind operation; hard to dismiss.

races.name: Next Meeting Saturday 18th April Book Now Handicap

runners_data.name: Invincible Melody
runners_data.comment: Runner-up eight times but left Stuart Williams for 3,400gns and as a 22-race maiden
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up eight times but left Stuart Williams for 3,400gns and as a 22-race maiden; ran well when trying this headgear combination once before (early last year) but wouldn't be the percentage call.

runners_data.name: Ey Up He's A Star
runners_data.comment: Might be better on the AW but shaped encouragingly after a break at Newcastle last month
runners_data.spotlight: Might be better on the AW but shaped encouragingly after a break at Newcastle last month (7f) and he's not had many chances on grass; draw no help.

runners_data.name: Operation Gimcrack
runners_data.comment: Won two of his four races on the AW this year and has comparable form on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Won two of his four races on the AW this year (at 7f) and has comparable form on turf; wasn't beaten far last month at Newcastle despite losing a shoe.

runners_data.name: Blackjack
runners_data.comment: Much more effective on AW than on grass so recent efforts in that scene are discouraging
runners_data.spotlight: Much more effective on the AW than on grass so recent efforts in that scene are discouraging.

runners_data.name: Jkr Cobbler
runners_data.comment: Running fairly well this year and the handicapper's giving him every chance
runners_data.spotlight: Running fairly well this year and the handicapper's helped his cause; can sometimes miss the break but if giving himself a chance he might not be far away.

runners_data.name: Mwafaq
runners_data.comment: Lost his first ten races but won his last two, 7f handicaps at Wolverhampton in October
runners_data.spotlight: Lost his first ten races but won his last two, 7f handicaps at Wolverhampton in October (under Ethan Tindall); seems as effective on grass and just a question of how fit he'll be after his break; mark remains workable; not drawn great.

runners_data.name: Reidh
runners_data.comment: Historically well handicapped if Adam Kirby can get him going again
runners_data.spotlight: 2-25 for Richard Fahey, the wins coming in 2024 (one over C&D); left that yard out of form and for 10,000gns; historically well handicapped if Adam Kirby can get him going again; tries cheekpieces; market interesting.

runners_data.name: Good Karma
runners_data.comment: Can race keenly but if getting some cover from stall 4 he should be on the scene
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time winner and has been shaping as though his turn could be near once more, going down narrowly the last twice at Wolverhampton (7f); can race keenly but if getting some cover from stall 4 he should be on the scene.

runners_data.name: Sunny Orange
runners_data.comment: He does like Beverley and took a while to find his form last season
runners_data.spotlight: Hard to win with (4-43) and, although he has form elsewhere, he does like Beverley; took a while to find his form last season.

runners_data.name: Woodrafff
runners_data.comment: Running well for a while and latest effort in the new visor at Newcastle can be upgraded
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time winner who is fine at 7f or 1m; has been running well for a while and latest effort in the new visor at Newcastle can be upgraded.

runners_data.name: Jet Warrior
runners_data.comment: Down the field in 7f-1m2f maidens and goes handicapping with it all to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Down the field in 7f-1m2f maidens and goes handicapping with it all to prove.

runners_data.name: Filey Beach
runners_data.comment: Won twice over this trip last season and also ran well on his reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Poor in his last two races but now back with Ruth Carr for whom he won twice over this trip last season; also ran well on his reappearance.

runners_data.name: Angel Of England
runners_data.comment: Winless since 2023; just one effort of note last winter after a lengthy break; had wind op
runners_data.spotlight: Winless since 2023 and just one effort of note last winter after a lengthy break; had wind surgery during three months away; not wildly appealing.

runners_data.name: Oselton
runners_data.comment: Sole win and best form has been on the AW and likely best watched back on the grass
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win and best form has been on the AW and likely best watched back on the grass after a break.

races.name: Thirsk Hunt Cup Day Saturday 2nd May Book Now Apprentice Handicap

runners_data.name: Fiscal Policy
runners_data.comment: Has dropped to a dangerous mark and won't have a problem with the likely conditions
runners_data.spotlight: Out of the frame in all six starts since returning in October, but has dropped to a dangerous mark as a result and he won't have a problem with the likely conditions; off ten weeks, but has a good record fresh; could go well at a price.

runners_data.name: Juan Les Pins
runners_data.comment: Eight wins; 1lb well in after recent Doncaster second; 6f and drying ground no problem
runners_data.spotlight: Winner of eight races; fit from the AW when second of ten at Doncaster (5f, good to soft) 12 days ago; 1lb well in and return to 6f and drying ground wouldn't be a problem; high on list.

runners_data.name: Moonstone Boy
runners_data.comment: 8lb below last winning mark, but drying ground and return to 6f pose questions
runners_data.spotlight: Four wins over 5f for Iain Jardine, but unplaced in three starts on the AW since returning for this yard in January; 8lb below last winning mark, but drying ground and return to 6f pose questions; cheekpieces return.

runners_data.name: Great
runners_data.comment: Well beaten on his stable/seasonal debut at Southwell last month; enough to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Windsor maiden winner (6f, good to firm) for Richard Hannon in May last year and ran well in turf/AW handicaps afterwards, but having been gelded he was well beaten on his stable/seasonal debut at Southwell (7f, AW) last month; enough to prove.

runners_data.name: Lord Abama
runners_data.comment: All three turf wins have come over C&D on good to firm ground; very much of interest
runners_data.spotlight: Last few efforts have been modest, but all three turf wins have come over C&D on good to firm ground, while is is 3lb lower than for the latest last summer; has won fresh and very much of interest, especially if conditions continue to dry out; stable also runs Macedonian.

runners_data.name: One More Dream
runners_data.comment: Winner of 13 races, but quiet in two starts since returning in February; needs to step up
runners_data.spotlight: Winner of 13 races and just 1lb higher than for the latest, but quiet in two starts at Southwell (6f, AW) since returning in February; needs to step up.

runners_data.name: Macedonian
runners_data.comment: 1-14; has proved inconsistent for this yard and may need the run
runners_data.spotlight: 1-14, the win coming on handicap debut at Kempton (6f, AW) for the Crisfords in March last year; has proved inconsistent for this yard and may need the run; unraced on ground faster than good.

runners_data.name: Mark's Choice
runners_data.comment: Best known as a Ripon specialist; has tended to need his reappearance in recent years
runners_data.spotlight: Best known as a Ripon specialist with ten wins there, including his last two starts of 2025; has won fresh, but has tended to need his reappearance in recent years.

runners_data.name: Yorkshire Glory
runners_data.comment: Has been a revelation on AW since December but is 25lb higher than when last on turf (0-9)
runners_data.spotlight: Has been a revelation on the AW since December (322113413111111); possible that his progression has been general, but it will have to be if he is to win this as he is 25lb higher than when last on turf (0-9).

runners_data.name: Valentine Catcher
runners_data.comment: Has become well handicapped; has won fresh, but softer ground may suit best
runners_data.spotlight: Had dropped 9lb below his last winning mark when demoted after passing the post first at Pontefract (6f, good to soft; first-time cheekpieces) last September, but hasn't matched that form since; has won fresh and has been successful on good to firm ground, but a soft surface seems to suit him best; one of three from stable.

runners_data.name: Hurt You Never
runners_data.comment: Back off her last winning mark and has won after an absence; shortlisted
runners_data.spotlight: Mainly seen over 5f these days, but has won seven times over 6f; ended last season quietly, but is back off her last winning mark and has won after an absence; shortlisted.

runners_data.name: Maldevious
runners_data.comment: 0-6; last seen making a quiet stable debut at Southwell in November; has had a wind op
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner who is 0-6 and was last seen making a quiet stable debut at Southwell (7f, AW) in November; has undergone wind surgery since; unraced on ground faster than good and probably best watched.

runners_data.name: El Pinto
runners_data.comment: Showed ability in both starts as a 2yo, but has regressed in an abbreviated career since
runners_data.spotlight: Showed ability in both starts on soft ground as a 2yo, but has regressed in an abbreviated career since; best watched for now.

runners_data.name: Stirrup Cup
runners_data.comment: Opposable under the likely conditions and the run may be needed; cheekpieces on
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins have come over 6f on soft ground and remains 7lb higher than for the latest; opposable under the likely conditions and the run may be needed; cheekpieces replace blinkers.

runners_data.name: Belsito
runners_data.comment: May need this first start in six months and wouldn't want the ground to dry out too much
runners_data.spotlight: Scored twice on a soft surface over 6f at Hamilton last September, but was weak in the market when failing in his hat-trick bid at Pontefract (6f, soft) the following month; may need this first start in six months and wouldn't want the ground to dry out too much.

runners_data.name: Barmyblade
runners_data.comment: Won three times last spring and is back off the same mark as for the latest; could figure
runners_data.spotlight: Won three times last spring and is back off the same mark as for the latest, but he lost his form completely later in the season; proven fresh, though, and not the biggest surprise if he were to figure.
